question: where did attendance percentage decline the most year on year
gold_sql: WITH combined AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre, 2023 AS year, "Avg Daily Present" / "Enrolled Kids" * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2023 UNION ALL SELECT centre_name AS centre, 2024 AS year, average_attendance / enrolment * 100.0 AS rate FROM attendance_2024) , by_year AS (SELECT centre, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN rate END) AS avg_2023, AVG(CASE WHEN year = 2024 THEN rate END) AS avg_2024 FROM combined GROUP BY centre) SELECT centre, avg_2023 - avg_2024 AS drop_pp FROM by_year ORDER BY drop_pp DESC, centre LIMIT 1
sql_duckdb: WITH combined_2023 AS (SELECT "Centre" AS centre_name, "Month" AS month, "Avg Daily Present" AS average_attendance, "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolment FROM "attendance_2023"), combined_2024 AS (SELECT "centre_name", "month", "average_attendance", "enrolment" FROM "attendance_2024"), year_on_year AS (SELECT c1.centre_name, c1.month, c1.average_attendance AS avg_attendance_2023, c1.enrolment AS enrolment_2023, c2.average_attendance AS avg_attendance_2024, c2.enrolment AS enrolment_2024, NULLIF(c1.average_attendance, 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(c1.enrolment, 0), 0) * 100 AS attendance_pct_2023, NULLIF(c2.average_attendance, 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(c2.enrolment, 0), 0) * 100 AS attendance_pct_2024, (NULLIF(c2.average_attendance, 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(c2.enrolment, 0), 0) - NULLIF(c1.average_attendance, 0) / NULLIF(NULLIF(c1.enrolment, 0), 0)) * 100 AS pct_point_change FROM combined_2023 AS c1 JOIN combined_2024 AS c2 ON JARO_WINKLER_SIMILARITY(LOWER(TRIM(c1.centre_name)), LOWER(TRIM(c2.centre_name))) >= 0.9 AND c1.month = c2.month WHERE c1.centre_name IN ('Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi', 'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi', 'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi') AND c1.month IN ('April', 'August', 'December', 'February', 'January', 'July', 'June', 'March', 'May', 'November', 'October', 'September') AND c2.centre_name IN ('Chembur Balwadi', 'Dharavi Balwadi', 'Govandi Balwadi', 'Kurla Balwadi', 'Mankhurd Balwadi', 'Sion Balwadi', 'Wadala Balwadi', 'Worli Balwadi') AND c2.month IN ('April', 'August', 'December', 'February', 'January', 'July', 'June', 'March', 'May', 'November', 'October', 'September')) SELECT centre_name, month, attendance_pct_2023, attendance_pct_2024, pct_point_change FROM year_on_year ORDER BY pct_point_change ASC NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1

```sql
WITH combined AS (
    SELECT
        "Centre" AS centre,
        "Month" AS month,
        "Enrolled Kids" AS enrolled_2023,
        "Avg Daily Present" AS attendance_2023
    FROM "attendance_2023"

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS centre,
        "month" AS month,
        "enrolment" AS enrolled_2023,
        "average_attendance" AS attendance_2023
    FROM "attendance_2024"
    WHERE jaro_winkler_similarity(lower(trim("centre_name")), lower(trim("centre"))) < 0.9

    UNION ALL

    SELECT
        "centre_name" AS centre,
        "month" AS month,
        "enrolment" AS enrolled_2024,
        "average_attendance" AS attendance_2024
    FROM "attendance_2024"
),

attendance_comparison AS (
    SELECT
        c1.centre,
        c1.month,
        c1.attendance_2023 AS attendance_2023,
        c2.attendance_2024 AS attendance_2024,
        c1.enrolled_2023 AS enrolled_2023,
        c2.enrolled_2024 AS enrolled_2024,
        (c1.attendance_2023 / NULLIF(c1.enrolled_2023, 0)) * 100 AS percentage_2023,
        (c2.attendance_2024 / NULLIF(c2.enrolled_2024, 0)) * 100 AS percentage_2024,
        ((c2.attendance_2024 / NULLIF(c2.enrolled_2024, 0)) * 100) -
            ((c1.attendance_2023 / NULLIF(c1.enrolled_2023, 0)) * 100) AS percentage_point_change
    FROM combined c1
    JOIN combined c2 ON c1.centre = c2.centre AND c1.month = c2.month
    WHERE c1.attendance_2023 IS NOT NULL AND c2.attendance_2024 IS NOT NULL
    AND c1.enrolled_2023 IS NOT NULL AND c2.enrolled_2024 IS NOT NULL
)

SELECT
    centre,
    month,
    percentage_point_change
FROM attendance_comparison
WHERE percentage_point_change < 0
ORDER BY percentage_point_change ASC
LIMIT 1
```
